Independent dimension and parameter arithmetic
sources.details: Linear y=xW.T with W=I,2I,swap gives [1,2],[2,4],[2,1]; each bias-free2x2 table has4 parameters,3 independent tables12 and one shared table4. For width64 hidden256, up/down with biases has64*256+256+256*64+64=33088;2 layers*4 experts*33088=264704;2*64*4 routers=512;264704+512+75392=340608. No rounding or per-token quality denominator is involved.
